acip: MA GRUB NA, DE CHOS CAN, DER THAL, RTAG PA YIN NA, KHYOD DANG RTAG PA'I GZHI MTHUN YIN PAS KHYAB PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, de chos can, der thal, rtag pa yin na, khyod dang rtag pa'i gzhi mthun yin pas khyab pa'i phyir
english: [It's not correct to say that a thing which is not made is such that being it is not contradictory to being an unchanging thing.] Suppose you say it's not correct. Consider this same thing. It is so, Because anything which is an unchanging thing is such that it is one thing which is both itself and unchanging. _______________
